newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Texaco year EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Texaco year EPS raised.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 23 (Reuter) ABN AMRO First Chicago Corp analyst Eugene Nowak has raised his year earnings per share forecast to $6.45 from $6.35 after the company's second quarter earnings yesterday.
The stock was up 0-3/4 to 114-5/8 after having been opened at 117.

Texaco is Nowak's favorite stock among the oil majors. He notes that it is trading on the lowest price earnings ratio, it has potential for dividend growth, the best production profile and the superior growth outlook.
